errors.evidence: The bars are not ordered alphabetically by country name; they are ordered in descending order based on their value.
The y-axis values are decimals ranging from 0.0000 to 1.0000, not values in the thousands.
The y-axis scale has major intervals of 0.1000 and a maximum value of 1.0000, not intervals of 200,000 up to 1,000,000.
The highest bar (for the United Kingdom) has a value of approximately 0.92, not 1,000,000. The value 1.0000 is the maximum limit of the axis.
The lowest bar (for Romania) has a value of approximately 0.57, not 400,000 (or 0.4).
